Name: Speed-Gro Level Up
Author: Furuchooo
Description:
Based on Upgrade Sprinkles by OchoLinda

Use normal speed-gro to craft deluxe ones and use deluxe to craft hypers in a rate of 4 to 1

You learn Normal to Deluxe at Level 6 Farming and Deluxe to Hyper at Level 9

This is my first mod so please leave a feedback.
